content.short: ZeroLend is an efficient, cross-chain lending protocol operating across L2 networks like zkSync and Linea.
content.description: ZeroLend is a highly scalable, decentralized lending and borrowing protocol built to operate seamlessly across multiple Layer 2 networks, including zkSync and Linea. By utilizing zero-knowledge rollups and advanced cryptographic security, the platform provides users with lightning-fast execution and significantly reduced transaction costs. ZeroLend is designed to offer deep liquidity markets, robust liquidation engines, and highly capital-efficient yield generation.
